sourceTitle: The Wye and Its Associations: A Picturesque Ramble
description: "The Wye and Its Associations: A Picturesque Ramble" by Leitch Ritchie is a travel narrative written in the early 19th century. This work explores the scenic beauty and historical significance of the River Wye, one of England's most celebrated rivers, from its source on Plinlimmon to its confluence with the Severn.
